items.title: Oracle Falls 3% While Cloud Rivals Hold Their Ground; Microsoft Dips, Amazon Nudges Higher
items.summary: Oracle is sliding hard on a day when its cloud rivals are barely flinching, and the reason behind that split tells investors something important about where the real pressure on ORCL stock is coming from.

items.title: Credo Technology Group vs. Sandisk: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: One company is growing at a pace that is almost impossible to find in semiconductors. The other has reinvented itself as a contracted AI infrastructure play with billions in guaranteed revenue.

items.title: DTE Could Be One of the Quiet Winners of the Data Center Boom
items.summary: DTE Energy has been quietly signing contracts with some of the biggest hyperscalers on the planet, and the numbers behind that pipeline suggest most investors are not yet pricing in what it could mean for earnings growth.

items.title: Can Hewlett Packard Enterprise Stock Keep Running On Orders It Cannot Ship?
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has returned 156% over the trailing twelve months, and the stock now sits right at the top of its 52-week range. The next leg is the hard one. What could power it is already on the company's books: orders it has taken and cannot yet ship.

items.title: What Happens To Snowflake Stock If AI Keeps Costing It Margin?
items.summary: Snowflake (SNOW) has returned about 53% over the past year, and its product revenue growth has accelerated for three straight quarters. In early September, the company cut its fiscal 2027 non-GAAP product gross margin guide by a point, to 74%, pointing to a heavier mix of fast-growing AI workloads that carry a lower contribution margin. So what happens to the stock if that mix keeps shifting.

items.title: 3 Reasons to Hold Microsoft Stock After a 31.2% Surge in 3 Months
items.summary: MSFT's cloud and AI momentum, broad enterprise adoption and durable growth outlook give investors reasons to hold despite its 31.2% surge.

items.title: Oracle's CEO just sold $1.5 million in stock as shares rebound
items.summary: The sale was planned months ago, but its timing comes as Oracle's AI business and its stock move in very different directions.
